from.place: proof, the preliminary fact needed to apply flat cohomology base change: properness of X descends from properness of X_K

title: Properness descends along a field extension
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] and let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-pc-scheme]. If the base change $X_K:=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-pc-base-change] is proper over $K$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], then $X$ is proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism].

mathlib_searches.query: proper morphism descends along a field extension when the base change is proper
mathlib_searches.results: Returned IsProper.isStableUnderBaseChange and properness consequences; no converse/descent theorem for a field extension.
No declaration establishing IsProper from a faithfully flat or field base change; only stability under base change and composition appeared.
No properness descent declaration in Mathlib source.
